blocks.title: Google Summer of Code (GSoC)
blocks.text:
Since 2011, The Processing Foundation has participated in Google’s global open-source education initiative Google Summer of Code. 
College-level students are paired with mentors from the community and are paid a stipend to develop open-source projects that focus on the development, enhancement, and accessibility of Processing and p5.js. GSoC projects have been as wide-ranging as library development to community outreach. [Learn more](https://github.com/processing/Processing-Foundation-GSoC)
